llm_response.reason: The website hosts an exact copy of the Google homepage on a suspicious and unrelated domain ('nojima.ru.com'), spoofing legitimate company branding (Characteristic #16). None of the linked domains or the site content matches actual Google or Nojima web assets. The domain is not official, is registered to a generic registrar, and only serves as a lookalike page, matching the common tactics of phishing or fake online shopping scams. All these factors are classic indicators of a scam website.
